# Data dictionary

**Schema:** `banking_capstone` — entirely fictional records generated by `sql/00_setup_database.sql`.

## `bank_branches` (one row per branch)
| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| branch_id | INTEGER, PK | Identifier for a branch |
| branch_name | TEXT | Branch's display name |
| city | TEXT | Branch city |
| province | TEXT | Zambian province of the branch |

## `bank_customers` (one row per customer)
| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| customer_id | INTEGER, PK | Identifier for a fictional customer |
| customer_name | TEXT | Generated fictional name, not a unique identifier |
| age | INTEGER | Customer age |
| monthly_income | NUMERIC(12,2) | Generated monthly income (ZMW) |
| branch_id | INTEGER, FK | Customer's linked branch |
| customer_since | DATE | Synthetic customer onboarding date |

## `bank_loans` (one row per original loan)
| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| loan_id | INTEGER, PK | Unique loan identifier |
| customer_id | INTEGER, FK | Borrower link to `bank_customers` |
| loan_type | TEXT | Personal, Business, Agriculture, Vehicle or Education |
| loan_amount | NUMERIC(14,2) | **Original loan principal (ZMW)**, not balance outstanding |
| interest_rate | NUMERIC(5,2) | Nominal rate percentage used for synthetic reporting |
| loan_term_months | INTEGER | Original loan term in months |
| disbursement_date | DATE | Synthetic disbursement date |
| loan_status | TEXT | Active, Defaulted or Paid (synthetic classification) |

All reported figures come from the original locally generated dataset; see `README.md` for reproducibility limitations.
